remarks: Welcome to 37 Seaview Ave in the attractive East Norwalk! EVERYTHING IS NEWER! Water views of the L.I Sound won't disappoint. Just a hop, skip and a jump from the L.I Sound/Veterans Park (Oyster Festival), SONO, many shops/restaurants & MORE! Enjoy the 4th of July Fireworks from the front yard! Commuter friendly also! Just minutes from East Norwalk/South Norwalk Train Stations, I95 (Exit 16), Rt7 & MORE! This second floor unit includes 1 spacious bedroom, 1 full bathroom, living room & EIK. Hardwood floors throughout, newer kitchen/bathroom, plenty of closet/cabinet storage + many windows for natural light make you feel right at home. Additional storage + Laundry in basement. Natural Gas for heat, hot water & cooking help keep utilities cost LOW! Yard space for grilling, relaxing & enjoying WATER VIEWS! Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references. Plenty of parking on Seaview Ave or Betts Place. Pets are case by case basis/ No smoking allowed.
